message:
8 string literals reach the DOM from an expression:
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.title]` → "Close the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.placeholder]` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.aria-placeholder]` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.aria-valuetext]` → "Delete the row"
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.alt]` → "Delete "
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.abbr]` → "Delete "
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.label]` → " and "
      libs/components/widget/src/widget.ts: host `[attr.download]` → "Delete the row"
description: Sentences in the positions of a value of a `host` block's speaking bindings, read as a template's are (`ExpressionLiterals`): a conditional's branch, the operands of `??` and `||` and the right one of `&&`, a concatenation, the words of a template literal, the separator an array's method is handed, and an item read off an array (measured: each drawn, through JIT and a render in jsdom). The block was read by a regular expression over quotes, which took a comparison's operand for a word and the words of a template literal for none; so the refusal counts eight.
